I compared several schedules of month-long periods and picked the one that misses the fewest (episode, follower) pairs. This was a manual search over the strongest options, not an exhaustive proof that nothing better exists.

**Constraints that shape the plan**
- Only one non-required service can have access on any day.
- From Nov 1 to Nov 4, Marquee and Orbit are both already paid, which exceeds the limit. Through Nov 15, Marquee's already-paid access fills the single slot. So no new period can give access before Nov 16.
- The Marquee access that is already paid covers *The Paper Kingdom* and *Hollow Meridian*: 15 pairs at no cost.
- Northline must have access during Feb 1–8. That is when all of *The Quiet Meridian* releases (16 pairs) and *The Glass Archive* becomes available. This forces Marquee before Northline and Pebble after it.
- Tidewell and Kestrel+ can't fit without displacing more valuable periods.

**Chosen plan (back-to-back, no overlaps)**

| Period | Service | Pairs caught | Main titles |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dec 10 – Jan 10 | Marquee | 22 | *Northern Garden* episodes 2–6, *Amber Signal* episodes 1–2, *Silver Meridian* episodes 1–4 for all three followers, *Crooked Tide* |
| Jan 10 – Feb 10 | Northline | 43 | *Distant Atlas* (Ines all 7, Nora 6, Ivy 5), *Quiet Meridian* (all 16), *Glass Archive* (all 8), *Salt Kingdom* episode 7 |
| Feb 10 – Mar 10 | Pebble Kids | 26 | *Copper Harbor* mid-season episodes, *Amber Orchard* episodes 6–10 |
| Mar 10 – Apr 10 | Pebble Kids | 6 | *Copper Harbor* episodes 11–12 for Nora, Marcus and Ivy |

**Result**
- 112 of 192 pairs are watched in time (97 from new periods plus the 15 already paid).
- Total cost is $41.96.
- Close alternatives scored 96 or fewer pairs. These included adding an early Northline period in November, or using Marquee instead of a second Pebble period after Northline.
